items.headline: The valuation read is being pulled by sentiment
items.detail: The composite sits at the 21th percentile, but the sentiment axis is at 77 while the rest average 27 — the one dimension running hot.
items.framing: Everything is cheap except sentiment, which reads 77/100. That divergence is the story — it's how the exchange-flow build-up first became visible.
items.checkable: Each axis is a percentile of its own history; published weights on the Methods page.

items.headline: 2 new proven top-timers in 90 days
items.detail: Wallet(s) that just crossed the ROI+capital bar by selling a top at profit — a burst means distribution is starting.
items.framing: 2 wallet(s) newly qualified as smart money in 90d (sold a top at ≥5× ROI). Low count = quiet market; a spike is the tell.
items.checkable: First crossing of the ROI+capital bar per wallet, from the sale history.

items.headline: 7.32M SPX left in a day at a loss
items.detail: 2026-09-23: 72 wallets dropped below the 5k bar with 7.32M SPX, 7.9σ above the usual churn — loss-led (capitulation).
items.framing: A loss-led exit wave — the worrying kind: 72 wallets left 7.32M SPX underwater. Say "left/dropped below the bar", not "dumped".
items.checkable: Wallets whose balance fell below the 5k residency bar that day, split by exit vs entry price.

items.headline: SPX just moved into the Fire Sale band
items.detail: Price $0.429 crossed from BUY! into Fire Sale within the week — a band change the daily rotation won't announce on its own.
items.framing: SPX moved into the Fire Sale band this week. A clean "where are we on the rainbow" post even though no per-band fire triggered.
items.checkable: Current price vs the frozen power-law band edges (published model).

items.headline: Holders ~14% underwater — and still not selling
items.detail: MVRV 0.86: price is 14% below the crowd's avg on-chain cost basis ($0.5). Yet 58% of supply is in the longest-held tier — the float isn't moving.
items.framing: Maximum financial pain, minimal capitulation — conviction being tested and, so far, holding.
items.note: Describe the divergence, NOT a bottom call. "Not selling", not "buy".

items.headline: -81% below its all-time high
items.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -95%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
items.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
items.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

items.headline: SPX's MVRV 0.86 = 8th percentile of Bitcoin's history
items.detail: SPX's MVRV of 0.86 sits at the 8th percentile of Bitcoin's entire MVRV history — as cheap as BTC's generational bottoms.
items.framing: MVRV is unitless, so it's comparable: SPX today is at BTC's 8th percentile. BTC was only this cheap at major bottoms.
items.note: A position on BTC's map, not a date-match forecast.

items.headline: -82% below its long-run trend (Fire Sale band)
items.detail: Fair value for its age is $2.32; price sits -82% under it.
items.framing: Where today sits in the long power-law arc.

items.headline: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 91% of today's never sold to zero
items.detail: Of 26,882 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,339 remain (80% churned). Yet 91% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
items.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
items.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.

items.headline: Smart money still net-selling (-15.1% over 12w)
items.detail: The 10-wallet cohort of proven top-timers (ROI ≥5×, still holding) holds 6.96M SPX. 4w -13.3% · 12w -15.1% · 26w -22.5%.
items.framing: Smart money hasn't started buying yet (-15.1% in 12w). Honest "not the bottom signal yet" read.
items.checkable: A recomputed cohort of wallets with realized ROI ≥5× that still hold ≥50k SPX; net flow of their combined balance.

items.headline: Average holder went underwater
items.detail: Price $0.429 slipped below the crowd's cost basis $0.499.
items.framing: The average holder is now underwater — price dipped below the on-chain average cost basis ($0.499). Honest dip context; pairs with the Fire Sale narrative.

items.headline: NUPL -0.16 — capitulation
items.detail: Net unrealised profit/loss is -0.16 (from MVRV 0.86) — the market sits in the capitulation zone.
items.framing: Aggregate holder profitability. Below zero = the crowd is underwater, historically an accumulation zone.
items.note: A position read, not a signal.

items.headline: -1.2σ below its trend vs the alt market
items.detail: SPX ÷ the alt sector (ex-BTC/ETH/stables), detrended, sits 1.2σ below its own trend — cheap vs alts.
items.framing: Relative value vs the whole alt sector — -1.2σ cheap. SPX structurally outperforms alts, so this is deviation from ITS trend, not parity.
items.note: A relative-value position, not a signal.

items.headline: SOPR 1.068 — coins moving at a profit
items.detail: Spent-output profit ratio is 1.068: coins that moved on-chain realised a gain on average. Sustained <1 = capitulation, >1 = profit-taking.
items.framing: On-chain realised behaviour — profit-taking (SOPR 1.068).
items.note: Only coins that MOVED; a behaviour read, not a signal.

items.headline: 236,665 holders across 3 chains

items.framing: The real reach: 236,665 wallets across three chains — most people on Base/Solana, most value on ETH.
items.note: Wallets, not people; Base/Solana are bridged.
